title: Meeting agenda
description: When a meeting that has no agenda is read for one somebody stated. The default is the value the stack was deployed with; a value set here is used instead until it is reset.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes, to meetings that reach the threshold after that.

autoDeriveAfterSeconds.title: Seconds into a meeting to look for a stated agenda
autoDeriveAfterSeconds.description: How far into a meeting with no agenda its transcript is read, once, for an agenda somebody stated; one found is saved to the meeting. 0 turns the automatic pass off. The Agenda panel's Derive agenda button works either way. Default: the AgendaDerivationAfterSeconds stack parameter.
